flora: Succulent needle (thick, scale-like, rounded water-storing form)
Male pollen cone (small, cylindrical, dusty yellow texture)
Female seed cone (spherical, tightly closed scales, woody)
Fossilized branchlet (preserved in siltstone, showing scale patterns)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; succulent leaves appear plump and 'soft-touch'; cones have chunky, geometric scales; vibrant greens contrasting with the dusty rose earth.

visual_logic.composition: Quadrant composition: Top-Left: a close-up of the scale-like succulent needles; Top-Right: a cluster of male pollen cones; Bottom-Left: a mature spherical female cone; Bottom-Right: an impression of a branch in a slab of salmon-colored siltstone.
visual_logic.ground: Dry, cracked playa mud with white crystalline salt flecks.
visual_logic.lighting: Studio-style soft lighting to emphasize the plump, 3D volume of the succulent needles.
